title: Ground floor level requirements
previewText: An easement volume shall be excluded from any ground floor level requirements of this Resolution, including, but not limited to, the location of such ground floor in relation to the adjoining sidewalk level, restrictions of types of use, the minimum depth for certain uses, maximum width for certain uses, minimum transparency requirement, and parking wrap and screening requirements.
